title: Supplementary vulnerability monitoring needs authorized schedule and remediation records
remediation: The deployment vulnerability management and patch owners define scoped monitoring and scan frequencies, new finding triggers, detection-content update rules and remediation time targets. Review redacted reports from already authorized assessments, scope and content update records, and a sampled finding through remediation verification. Retain approved disposition for scope or timing gaps.

milestones.title: Collect an authorized assessment scope and schedule, dated monitoring and content update evidence, and a remediation and verification trace
